command:
set -euo pipefail
D=/tmp/omega777-pr62-0eb8bd63831f
if [ -e "$D" ]; then echo "REFUSE_EXISTING_SCRATCH=$D" >&2; exit 9; fi
git clone --quiet --filter=blob:none https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$D"
git -C "$D" checkout --quiet --detach 0eb8bd63831f2d89fa403ad2b83b2540a56e00de
printf 'EXACT_HEAD='; git -C "$D" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'ORIGIN_MAIN='; git -C "$D" rev-parse origin/main
git -C "$D" diff --check origin/main...HEAD
cd "$D"
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_arm_bus.py tests/test_voice777_local_audio_arm.py tests/test_voice777_multiarm_integration.py tests/test_voice777_pocket_renderer.py tests/test_voice777_omni_presence.py
